meta.description: Wholesale supplier for retailers and traders in Thailand and Southeast Asia. Request a quote online or call us.

hero.title: Wholesale products for retailers and traders across Southeast Asia
hero.text: Choose what you need, send one request, and we reply directly with price, availability and delivery.

facts.title: Clear terms
facts.text: Unit weight and minimum order on every product

facts.title: Direct contact
facts.text: No checkout: we reply by phone or email

steps.title: Choose products
steps.text: Browse the range and add what you need to your quote list.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.text: Tell us who you are and send the list. It reaches us by email.

steps.title: We reply directly
steps.text: We confirm price, availability and delivery with you by phone or email.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.text: Call or email us for prices, availability and delivery.

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.text: Nothing optional is switched on until you choose. You can change your choice at any time from Privacy settings in the footer.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your privacy choice and your quote list while you browse. Always on.
consent.analyticsText: Counts visits so we can improve the site. Off unless you agree.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft structure for review by a Thai adviser. Replace each bracket before launch.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: [Registered company name, address and contact details of The Amanah Trading.]

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: Only what you enter in the quote form: name, company, email, phone number (optional), country, message and the items you list. Optional analytics only if you agree.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: To reply to your quote request. [Lawful basis to be confirmed.]

sections.title: Who receives it
sections.text: The form service Web3Forms and its processors, our hosting provider Cloudflare, and our email provider Purelymail. [Confirm the full list and whether data leaves Thailand.]

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You may ask to see, correct or delete your data and withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us. You may also complain to the data protection authority. [Confirm wording.]
